title: Blockfall
description: A falling-block puzzle in 3D. Painted stone blocks drop into a gold-edged glass well, and a ghost shows where each piece will land. Fill a layer and its blocks flash and shatter into stone chips that tumble to the floor. A warm spot light and a cool sun cast the shadows, which only redraw while something moves.
line: A 3D falling-block puzzle in stone and glass. Clear a layer and it shatters.
hint: arrows move · Z X C rotate · space drops · Q E turn the view · drag to orbit
